facts.text: John expressed support for Tim's injury recovery and mentioned that the doctor indicated the injury was not too serious.

evidence.quote: Sure thing, Tim! Got your back. I hope so too. The doctor said it's not too serious.

facts.text: Tim expressed relief upon hearing that the injury was not too serious.

evidence.quote: That's good to hear, I'm glad.

facts.text: John expressed frustration about not being able to play on the court due to his injury.

evidence.quote: I hate not being on the court.
